results.description: The lab search page reflects the query parameter without encoding, so a crafted link executes script in a victim browser.
results.impact: An attacker could execute script in a victim's browser session and act on their behalf.
results.remediation: Encode all reflected output and apply context-appropriate output encoding.
results.steps_to_reproduce:
Open   the LAB search page.
2. Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in the search box.
3. Observe execution.
results.title: Reflected XSS in search box

results.description: The same unencoded reflection is reachable through the URL query string, so a victim only has to open a crafted link.
results.impact: A crafted link executes script in the victim's browser, stealing session context without any form interaction.
results.remediation: Apply the same output encoding to the query-string reflection path as to the search box.
steps_to_reproduce: Submit the payload via the URL query string.
results.title: Reflected XSS via URL query string

results.description: Unhandled errors return a full stack trace to the client, disclosing internal paths and library versions.
